steps: Vertical mirror reverses order: U W X J M, each letter flipped horizontally
U, W, X, M symmetric; J becomes reversed J
A and C show M in place of W (vertical flip) -> wrong; B and C keep J unreversed -> wrong; B ends in W
D: U W X reversed-J M -> correct
check_code:
def mirror(s):
    # s: list of (char, state) where state 'n' normal; mirror reverses order and toggles horizontal flip
    return [(c, 'h' if st=='n' else 'n') for c,st in reversed(s)]

src=[(c,'n') for c in "MJXWU"]
m=mirror(src)
sym=set("UWXM")
norm=[(c,'n' if c in sym else st) for c,st in m]
opts={"A":[("U","n"),("M","n"),("X","n"),("J","h"),("M","n")],
      "B":[("U","n"),("W","n"),("X","n"),("J","n"),("W","n")],
      "C":[("U","n"),("M","n"),("X","n"),("J","n"),("M","n")],
      "D":[("U","n"),("W","n"),("X","n"),("J","h"),("M","n")]}
assert norm==opts["D"]
for k in "ABC": assert norm!=opts[k]

steps: Mirror at right reverses order: 2 4 > 3 / 9 -> each char flipped: reversed 2, reversed 4, <, reversed 3, \, reversed 9
A: slash and 3 unflipped -> wrong
C: vertically flipped (water image) -> wrong
D: / and 9 unflipped -> wrong
B matches

def mirror(s):
    # s: list of (char, state) where state 'n' normal; mirror reverses order and toggles horizontal flip
    return [(c, 'h' if st=='n' else 'n') for c,st in reversed(s)]

src=[(c,'n') for c in "9/3>42"]
m=mirror(src)
# '>' flipped is '<', '/' flipped is '\\'
opts={"A":[("2","h"),("4","h"),(">","h"),("3","n"),("/","n"),("9","h")],
      "B":[("2","h"),("4","h"),(">","h"),("3","h"),("/","h"),("9","h")],
      "C":[("2","v"),("4","v"),(">","v"),("/","v"),("3","v"),("9","v")],
      "D":[("2","h"),("4","h"),(">","h"),("3","h"),("/","n"),("9","n")]}
assert m==opts["B"]
for k in "ACD": assert m!=opts[k]

answer_value: 4 ovals, long rectangles top and bottom, square in centre
method: Eliminate options: unfold (reverse the vertical and horizontal folds)
steps: Paper folded right-onto-left then top-onto-bottom; fold edges are right (vertical centre) and top (horizontal centre) of the final quarter
Oval away from folds -> 4 ovals
Square notch at the corner where both folds meet -> one axis-aligned square at centre (not a diamond)
Rectangle touching vertical fold -> one long rectangle across the vertical centre line, reflected to top and bottom
A,B have a diamond centre; B,C have split rectangles; C lacks centre square -> D
check_code:
# represent each cut as (shape, touches_vfold, touches_hfold)
cuts=[("oval",False,False),("square",True,True),("rect",True,False)]
res={}
for s,v,h in cuts:
    n=(1 if v else 2)*(1 if h else 2)
    shape={"square":"centre_square","rect":"long_rect"}.get(s,s) if v else s
    res[shape]=res.get(shape,0)+n
opts={"A":{"oval":4,"long_rect":2,"diamond":1},"B":{"oval":4,"short_rect":4,"diamond":1},
      "C":{"oval":4,"long_rect":2,"small_rect":4},"D":{"oval":4,"long_rect":2,"centre_square":1}}
assert res==opts["D"]
for k in "ABC": assert res!=opts[k]
